title: Iterating the loop length below MAXLENGTH
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  During the pool deployment, the transaction reverts for a pool with the length of tokens below `MAXLENGHT` which is `32`:  - [link](https://github.com/lucidlyfi/lucidly-core-v1/blob/f00c45bbadc836b9eaa94717a0b3aa017e792588/src/Pool.sol#L160)  It reverts with the out-of-bound error, so it is required to provide a long length of token of 32, which is not always the case.  ## Recommendations  The loop should iterate up to `_numTokens`. Or the loop should use this pattern from other functions when the loop reaches the final ite
